monorepo.title: Monorepo — Turborepo + pnpm
monorepo.claim: One repo, many apps, zero duplicated code.
monorepo.desc: Turborepo's task graph builds packages in dependency order with caching, while pnpm workspaces link internal packages without publishing. Shared config and UI ship to every app from a single source of truth.

designSystem.title: Shared Design System
designSystem.claim: UI primitives every app consumes, never copies.
designSystem.desc: A dedicated package of component primitives, CSS custom properties and typography tokens. Change a token once and every application in the workspace updates consistently.

flags.title: Context-based Feature Flags
flags.claim: Ship features dark, release them remotely.
flags.desc: A Context-driven flag system that enables remote-controlled rollouts, A/B tests and gradual releases — no redeploy needed to turn a feature on or off.

feature.title: Feature-based Architecture
feature.claim: Each domain owns its views, hooks, APIs and services.
feature.desc: Features are isolated modules with strict boundaries — nothing reaches into another feature's internals. New domains scale the codebase horizontally instead of deepening the tangle.

components.title: Compound & Headless Components
components.desc: Compound components share state implicitly through Context for composable APIs; headless hooks own the behaviour and let each consumer control the markup completely.

hooks.title: Server State — TanStack Query
hooks.desc: Query hooks with tuned stale/GC times, background refetching, optimistic mutations and precise cache invalidation — server state treated as its own architectural layer.

services.title: Dependency Inversion (DIP)
services.claim: UI depends on interfaces, never on APIs.
services.desc: Views talk to TypeScript interfaces; concrete API clients implement them. Swapping a backend, mocking in tests, or migrating transports never touches the component layer.

mappers.title: DTO → Domain Mapping
mappers.claim: Transport types stop at the boundary.
mappers.desc: Every API payload is mapped into a clean domain model at the edge. The rest of the app works with stable, intention-revealing types the backend can't accidentally break.

items.summary: Engineered scalable React applications on a feature-based modular architecture inside a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with shared Design System packages. Implemented fully type-safe routing with TanStack Router, server-state management with TanStack Query, and advanced patterns — Compound & Headless components, DIP with DTO mappers, and a Context-based feature-flag system for gradual rollouts.

Built and shipped responsive full-stack apps with the Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS v4 and MUI, backed by Node.js/Express REST services and MongoDB models via Mongoose. Normalized complex JSON datasets into clean UI components and delivered analytics dashboards that gave end users clear operational insight.

Architected an end-to-end notification system and redesigned multiple screens to a unified UX spec, defining an app-wide color and design-token system. Tuned change detection and refactored components to cut rendering overhead, and ran systematic QA on every feature before release.

rickmorty.name: Rick & Morty Character Explorer
rickmorty.desc: A character browser over the Rick and Morty REST API with real-time search, filtering and pagination. Custom TanStack Query hooks with tuned stale/GC times deduplicate requests, and typed error boundaries recover with one-click retry — all on a fully typed, generic API layer.

weather.name: Weather App
weather.desc: A live weather dashboard on Next.js 15 and React 19. TanStack Query handles server state while Jotai atoms drive client state; a dedicated utility layer converts units and switches day/night iconography. Deployed on Vercel.

transportation.name: Amana Transportation
transportation.desc: A public-transport tracker rendering live bus positions and routes on interactive Leaflet maps. Backed by a Next.js API route, typed domain models and dynamic per-bus detail pages. Deployed on Vercel.

financial.name: Amana Financial
financial.desc: A fundraising platform connecting donors with education, agriculture and small-business causes across the Middle East. A typed service layer consumes a live REST API to render category-coloured cause cards with funding progress and urgency indicators.
